{{Otheruses|Emissary}}
The '''Emissary''' was a divine being foreseen in the ''[[Song of the Emissary]]''. Known by the [[Sharu/Legends|Toka]] people, it was said that it would accompany the [[Key Bearer]] to the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]] in order to activate the [[Mindharp of Sharu/Legends|Mindharp]].
